finalText:
Written to `incident-handoff.md`.

Short version: `dep-4471` flipped a gateway setting so every request grabbed its own database connection instead of sharing the pool. The pool, fixed at 20 connections, ran dry in 37 seconds. First failure hit at 2:14:18 AM, and by the last line in the log, 3:59:27 AM, it was still failing and getting worse, not better. Only the gateway was hurt. The worker log covers the same stretch with zero errors.

Roll back `dep-4471`, specifically the `gateway.pool.perRequest` setting back to `false`.
